| description = Pansies are spawned by traps in the Plane of Mischief forest area. They are extreme undercons; while they are approximately level 40, they have both the damage and the hitpoints of a level 50+ mob. They are ''very'' fast, below SOW speed but not by much. They will despawn a short time after losing aggro (not always instantly). They spawn in groups of 1-3.

Unlike every other mob in Plane of Mischief, other mobs do not assist them.

Most of the traps are in the central or eastern area of the forest. There are no traps, or very few, in the far western quarter, where the zone-out tree and the KOS Treasure Chest are.

Their names can include:

* an angry pansy
* a dandy pansy
* a pretty ugly pansy
* a puny pansy
